groups.title: Redis Data Structures
groups.question: Explain how you would use Redis in an API, and how you pick the right data structure for the job.

followUps.Strings, Hashes & TTL Expiry: When would you store data in a hash instead of a string, and what happens if cached keys never get a TTL?
followUps.Sorted Sets for Rate Limiting & Leaderbo: How would a sorted set help you build a leaderboard or a sliding-window rate limiter?

groups.title: HTTP Caching
groups.question: Explain how HTTP caching works between your API, a CDN and the browser, and how you control it.

followUps.Cache-Control Directives & CDN Interacti: What is the difference between no-cache and no-store, and which one should a response with private user data use?
followUps.ETag & Conditional Requests: How does an ETag let a client avoid downloading the same response again?

groups.title: Application-Level Caching
groups.question: Explain how you would add a cache in front of your database, and what makes it hard to get right.

followUps.Cache-Aside Pattern & Invalidation: Walk through a cache-aside read. What must happen to the cached copy when the data in the database changes?
followUps.N+1 Query Problem & the DataLoader Patte: Fetching 100 books and their authors runs 101 queries. Why, and how do you get it down to 2?

groups.title: Response Optimization
groups.question: Explain how you would make large API responses faster and cheaper to send.

followUps.gzip & Brotli Compression: How does the server know a client can accept a compressed response?
followUps.Pagination — Offset vs Cursor: Why does offset pagination get slower on deep pages, and how does cursor pagination avoid that?
